people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
translations.bsb: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
translations.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
translations.asv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I heard from God: this did not Abraham.
